WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM mesh
), mm AS (
  SELECT zoneref, res, geom, faces / (verts * res * res) * 1000 AS mcr FROM m
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
         COUNT(mm.zoneref) AS total_meshes,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mm.mcr > 5.0 AND mm.res < 1.0 AND mm.geom < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
         AVG(mm.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(mm.res) AS avg_res, AVG(mm.geom) AS avg_geom
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN mm ON mm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes AS high_fidelity_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * hf_meshes / NULLIF(total_meshes, 0), 2) AS high_fidelity_percentage,
       ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geom, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
       CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
            WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
            ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM agg
ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC NULLS LAST

WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.logregistry, r.arcref,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
         r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration r
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err / acc)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id, acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm,
       ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
       CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
            WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
            ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM x
ORDER BY rar DESC

WITH sb AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pdens,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
  JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = sc.arcref AND r.crewref = sc.crewref
), sm AS (
  SELECT zoneref, res, noise, acc, err,
         cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) AS sce,
         LOG(10, res * 1000) / LOG(10, pdens) * 5 AS sri
  FROM sb
), sq AS (
  SELECT zoneref, sce, noise, err, res,
         POWER(10 / sri, 1.5) * (sce / 100) * POWER(1 - noise / 30, 2) AS sqs,
         res / (acc * SQRT(1 + err / acc)) AS rar
  FROM sm
), site_scan AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(sqs) AS sqs, AVG(sce) AS sce, AVG(rar) AS rar,
         AVG(5 * SQRT(noise / 10)) AS noise_pen, AVG(2 * SQRT(err / res)) AS err_pen
  FROM sq GROUP BY zoneref
), mb AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric AS faces,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS mres,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom,
         (mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric AS tex
  FROM mesh
), site_mesh AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         AVG( (faces / (verts * mres * mres) * 1000)
              * ((tex / (SQRT(faces) * mres) * 0.01) / 10)
              * (1 + EXP(-geom)) ) AS mfs
  FROM mb GROUP BY zoneref
)
SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(0.3 * (0.4 * ss.sqs + 0.4 * m.mfs + 0.2 * ss.sce - ss.noise_pen)
             + 0.3 * m.mfs + 0.2 * ss.rar + 0.2 * ss.sce - ss.err_pen, 2) AS dpq
FROM sites s
JOIN site_scan ss ON ss.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
JOIN site_mesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY dpq DESC

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric
           / NULLIF((p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric * (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric, 0) AS pcdr,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cdens
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = sc.arcref AND sp.crewref = sc.crewref
), fe AS (
  SELECT pc.zoneregistry, pc.pcdr,
         ((f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric + (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric)
           / NULLIF(pc.pcdr * SQRT(pc.cdens), 0) * 1000 AS fee
  FROM pc LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = pc.zoneregistry
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(AVG(fee), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM fe
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH b AS (
  SELECT pr.flowregistry, pr.flowsoft, pr.flowstage,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         REPLACE(sc.size, ' GB', '')::numeric AS size_gb,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts
  FROM processing pr
  JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = pr.zoneref
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, size_gb * LOG(10, pts) / NULLIF(hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200, 0) AS per FROM b
), g AS (
  SELECT flowsoft, flowstage, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu,
         AVG(size_gb) AS avg_size, AVG(per) AS avg_per, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count
  FROM x GROUP BY flowsoft, flowstage
)
SELECT flowsoft AS software, flowstage AS stage, ROUND(avg_hrs, 1) AS avg_processing_hours,
       ROUND(avg_cpu, 1) AS avg_cpu_usage, ROUND(avg_gpu, 1) AS avg_gpu_usage, ROUND(avg_size, 1) AS avg_data_size_gb,
       ROUND(avg_per, 1) AS avg_per,
       CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
       workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per ASC

WITH g AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric) AS avg_temp,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric) AS avg_hum,
         AVG((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric) AS avg_lux,
         AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
 - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
 - 600 / ((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)) AS avg_esi
  FROM sites s JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(avg_temp, 1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_hum, 1) AS avg_humidity, ROUND(avg_lux, 1) AS avg_illumination,
       ROUND(avg_esi, 1) AS avg_esi,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
       CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM g
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS pdens,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM sites s
  JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
), m AS (
  SELECT *, LOG(10, res * 1000) / LOG(10, pdens) * 5 AS sri,
         cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100)) AS sce
  FROM b
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
       ROUND(AVG(POWER(10 / sri, 1.5) * (sce / 100) * POWER(1 - noise / 30, 2)), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM m
GROUP BY zoneregistry, zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (pr.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         REPLACE(sc.size, ' GB', '')::numeric AS size_gb,
         (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing pr ON pr.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.equipref = pr.equipref AND m.zoneref = pr.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = pr.zoneref
), x AS (
  SELECT equipregistry, hrs, cpu, gpu,
         hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / NULLIF(size_gb * 10 * LOG(10, verts + 10000), 0) AS pru
  FROM b
), g AS (
  SELECT equipregistry, AVG(pru) AS pru, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu
  FROM x GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id, ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru, ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru) AS efficiency_rank,
       CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
            WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
            WHEN pru > 10.0 THEN 'Needs Optimization'
            ELSE NULL END AS workflow_status,
       json_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM g
ORDER BY pru ASC
